veranderings.rede: With three areas and 'Die derde gebied' following, 'eerste' reads better than 'een'.
'Die ander' implies the other of two, but there are three areas; 'die tweede' fits the count.
As a regional name, Sentraal-Afrika takes a capital, like Suidoos-Asië in the next sentence.

veranderings.blok: Wat die kaarte van die reënwoude wys
veranderings.voor: Twee soorte kaart saam sê dus
veranderings.na: Saam wys die twee soorte kaarte dus
veranderings.rede: The original word order is stiff; this is more natural and matches the block's use of 'wys' for maps.

veranderings.blok: Bome wat in lae bo mekaar staan
veranderings.voor: op tot hoog by die blaredak
veranderings.rede: 'tot hoog by' is unidiomatic; 'tot by die blaredak' already says the plants reach the high canopy.

veranderings.blok: Diere wat in die bome leef
veranderings.voor: Die toekan pluk vrugte in die takke met sy groot bek.
veranderings.na: Die toekan pluk met sy groot bek vrugte in die takke.
veranderings.rede: At the end of the sentence 'met sy groot bek' seems to attach to 'die takke'; moving it removes the ambiguity.

veranderings.blok: Wat hierdie streek sy eie maak
veranderings.voor: Warm én nat in elke maand van die jaar maak hierdie streek sy eie.
veranderings.na: Hierdie streek se kenmerk is dat dit in elke maand van die jaar warm én nat is.
veranderings.rede: 'iets sy eie maak' is an anglicism; in Afrikaans it means to take something over, not to make it distinctive.

veranderings.blok: Wat hierdie streek sy eie maak
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb, so a comma is needed.

vlae.blok: Wat hierdie streek sy eie maak
vlae.teks: Wat hierdie streek sy eie maak
vlae.rede: The block heading has the same anglicism ('sy eie maak'); a heading cannot be changed by the script, so the writer should rephrase it, e.g. along the lines of what sets the region apart.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Party maande kry meer reën as ander en daardie verskil is soms groot
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Under AWS 2017 this needs a comma before 'en' (two clauses each with their own subject and verb: 'Party maande kry' and 'daardie verskil is'). The protected wording leaves it out; a person could add the comma to the protected entry and the lesson together.
